hints.love: Put both hands over your heart, sigh, gaze dreamily, and send a kiss.
hints.sleep: Lay your head on folded hands, close your eyes, and let your head slowly nod and droop.
hints.happiness: Smile broadly, jump up and down, spin, and throw your arms out wide.
hints.fear: Freeze with wide eyes, tremble, cover your face, and back away slowly.
hints.time: Tap your wrist, watch the second hand tick, and sweep your arm round like a clock.
hints.anger: Clench your fists, stomp, puff, turn red, and glare.
hints.dream: Close your eyes, float with a dreamy smile, and sketch a bubble above your head.
hints.silence: Press a finger to your lips, tiptoe, and freeze at every small noise.
hints.hunger: Rub your tummy, stare at food, and drool with sad eyes.
hints.luck: Cross your fingers, toss a coin, and jump for joy when it lands your way.
hints.freedom: Break free from chains, open your arms wide, and breathe deeply.
hints.surprise: Jump back, gasp, put your hands on your cheeks, and open your mouth wide.
hints.jealousy: Watch someone else with narrow eyes, fold your arms, and glance sideways.
hints.patience: Tap your foot slowly, take a deep breath, and wait calmly with folded hands.
hints.laziness: Slump on a couch, yawn, and wave a hand when asked to do anything.
hints.hope: Fold your hands in front of your chest, look up, and cross your fingers.
hints.boredom: Sigh, prop your head on a hand, doodle, and look at the clock again and again.
hints.shyness: Look at the floor, hide behind your hands, and peek out blushing.
hints.pride: Lift your chin, puff out your chest, and show off with a smile.
hints.curiosity: Tilt your head, lean in, peek inside things, and reach out slowly to touch.
hints.loneliness: Sit on your own, hug your knees, and look sadly at an empty seat.
hints.secret: Lean toward someone's ear with a hand cupped beside your mouth, glance around nervously, and lock your lips with an imaginary key.
hints.memory: Tap your temple, close your eyes, and slowly recall something, smiling.
hints.friendship: Walk side by side, put your arm over a shoulder, and share a laugh with a high five.
hints.peace: Close your eyes, breathe slowly, and hold up two fingers in a V.
hints.nostalgia: Look through an old photo album, smile sadly, and sigh as you remember.
hints.justice: Hold a pair of scales in your hands, then bang a hammer down firmly.
hints.gravity: Drop something, watch it fall, and show yourself being pulled down to the ground.
hints.infinity: Trace a sideways eight in the air again and again, and keep going forever.
hints.democracy: Raise your hand, drop a paper in a box, and count hands in a crowd.
hints.sarcasm: Roll your eyes, put on a flat fake smile, clap slowly, and nod with a smirk.
hints.inflation: Point at prices going up, then hold your wallet and watch it shrink.
hints.imagination: Close your eyes, wave your hands, and make shapes appear in the air with wonder.
hints.coincidence: Meet someone, point at each other, and show you both have the same thing in shock.
hints.temptation: Reach for something forbidden, pull back, look around, and grab it anyway.
hints.ambition: Climb a ladder one rung at a time, look up high, and reach for the top.
